summary_en: 70 yen/share special interim dividend (record date 2026-09-30, effective 2026-12-01), total 4.357 billion yen from retained earnings. Company states FY2026 results exceed plan; special dividend marks largest interim payout since founding. Stated intention to continue interim dividend in future periods.
title_en: Notice Regarding Implementation of Surplus Dividend (Special Dividend)
translation_en_brief: Tsuburaya Fields Holdings announced on 27 July 2026 that its board has resolved to pay a special interim dividend of 70 yen per share, with a record date of 30 September 2026 and an effective date of 1 December 2026. The total dividend will be approximately 4.357 billion yen, sourced from retained earnings. The company states that FY2026 results are tracking materially above plan, and this special dividend represents the largest interim payout in the company's history. The disclosure indicates that from the following fiscal year onward, the company intends to continue paying an interim dividend on a regular basis. The special dividend is framed as an Ultraman 60th anniversary commemoration, recognizing shareholder support for the company's growth.
